evidence.observation: The listed homes are "a new `src/gnd/commands/flatten.py` and its registration (`tools/gnd_entrypoints.json`, `tools/gnd_layers.json`)". At this checkout, `src/gnd/cli.py:625-676` explicitly registers each command with the parser; neither tools JSON file registers a CLI command. Following the listed homes leaves `gnd flatten` unavailable.

concerns.recommendation: Add `src/gnd/cli.py` to IR2's changed homes and specify its parser registration and dispatch.
concerns.title: IR2 does not register the new CLI command

evidence.observation: IR3 says the exporters "load the root with the composed loader, call `flatten_model`, and render the flat model's bytes" but gives no error mapping or invalid-include criterion. At this checkout, `src/gnd/commands/export.py:15-25` and `:45-55` map only `ExportInputError` to exit 3; other exceptions become `EXIT_INTERNAL`. The composed loader raises `ModelValidationError` for an include hash mismatch.

concerns.recommendation: Require both exporters to translate composed-loader and flattening input refusals into `ExportInputError`, and test a stale include pin in each export mode for exit 3 and its include code.
concerns.title: IR3 would classify invalid includes as internal failures

summary: IR2 omits the CLI registration needed to make its command available. IR3 omits input-error mapping and a refusal test for invalid includes.
